page.layout: One page of text, verse block at top right, then running prose in a column with marginal notes at the left; footnotes at the foot.

main_text.p: D Paulus explicatus.Et auctoritas etiam firma à D. Paulo 1. cujus hæc verba, Vt possi-tis comprehendere cum omnibus sanctis, qua sit latitudo & longitudo, & sublimitas & profundum, plerique Doctorum veterum referunt ad Crucem. Augustinus 2: Erat latitudo, in quâ porrecta sunt manus; longitudo à terrâ surgens, in quâ erat corpus infixum; altitudo, ab illo innexo ligno sursum quod eminet;
1 Ad Eph. c. iii. 2 In Psal. cxii. & alibi.

page.notes: Marginal notes at left: "Sive, potenti." beside the verse; "D Paulus explicatus." beside the prose paragraph. Footnote numerals 1 and 2 are superscript references. Some letters in the scan are faint; the verse line "Arctᴏn" reads as Arcton.
